scenarios.existing: Retrieval scripts, DOI registration checker resources, reproduction plan, ordered research stages, artifact hashes, metric contract, human finalization.
scenarios.missing: Plans and saved artifacts do not prove citation identity, claim support, full-text review, or a reproduced numerical result. Generic review scripts have no declared scientific runtime entry.
scenarios.supplement: Use this audit on paired execution observations and citations; fetch titled metadata. Preserve source, data/code versions, environment, comparison tolerances and human review separately.

scenarios.existing: Imported Primer3 resources and sequence retrieval, plus new optional standalone primer_check.py and validate_construct.py workspace CLIs with focused executed fixtures.
scenarios.missing: Local wrappers are available as lazy catalog entries science-primer-reference-check and science-construct-validation. Exact single-reference primer products do not establish assay specificity; vector reference/junction/CDS checks do not establish wet-lab assembly success.
scenarios.supplement: Implemented: real optional Primer3 design/Tm/hairpin/dimer calculations with explicit missing-dependency failure; both-strand exact amplicon coordinates and tails; tiled reference matching, circular junctions, strand/phase/CDS translation checks. Preserve source provenance and complete broader specificity/wet-lab validation separately.

scenarios.existing: Bounded deterministic FASTQ/count intake; Scanpy/PyDESeq2 script resources; declared Nextflow helper and scvi entries; QC library resources; artifact and metric contracts.
scenarios.missing: An imported script or seed is not a deterministic pipeline. Scanpy/PyDESeq2 lack declared scientific entries; single-cell QC entries are empty. No matched repeat-run dataset/environment/output comparison is established by this audit.
scenarios.supplement: Reuse existing science_workbench.inspect_scientific(kind='counts') for deterministic matrix QC; --run-fixtures executes repeat-run and invalid-matrix checks without duplicating QC logic. Full analysis still needs pinned inputs/environment/design and scientific output comparisons.

supplementImplemented: Paired call/result execution gate against catalog identity and resource digest.
Citation identifier membership in titled records from successful declared literature script output.
Offline CLI with failing exit status for invalid supplied evidence.
Optional standalone primer CLI with real Primer3 design/thermodynamics and bounded local exact products.
Standalone vector reference tiling, junction, circular-coordinate and CDS frame/protein checks.
Executed fixture option reuses existing matrix QC; does not implement a second matrix analyzer.

localSupplements.desktopPackaging: Source execution verified by fixtures; the separate release report covers the compressed catalog and packaged runtime.
localSupplements.dispatch: Lazy compressed resource entries dispatched by the bound scientific adapter.

limitations: Standalone audit only; no new live agent-loop or research-stage enforcement.
Trace authenticity is a caller trust boundary; forged observations are not detectable.
Identifier membership is not remote existence, DOI registration, title identity review, retraction screening or claim entailment.
Citation checks accept JSON stdout or the adapter's fresh declared-output read-back wrapper; bare file logs, XML and truncated records are not accepted.
No model acceptance, wet-lab validation, scientific reproduction or cross-platform execution claimed.
